title: Galnet Digest: The Complete Azimuth Saga
author: NoFoolLikeOne
excerpt: Galnet New Digest have kindly allowed us to host a transcript of their hour long Azimuth Saga video. Introduction Sometimes the news isn't the best way to tell a story. Sometimes you need the benefit of hindsight to see the sweep of a narrative, and to understand causes and consequences. This is the complete story…
